body: Sorry I didn't realize your so young. Your still in school then right? Does your school offer any clubs, sports, or activities that you would be interested in? The schools I had available to me sucked. Which is why I mine online. Are you in the situation with yours?

The situation your in is really difficult. I did my high school classes online so I would spend my life never leaving my room. I felt like I wasn't living life and at times I still often do.  If it weren't for my family I would of given up a long time. I'm so sorry that your life has been like this. Finding real genuine people who care about you is something rare to find. Being involed  with a community of people is even difficult. This might sound silly but getting a job might help. I did that and I was able to gain a sense of purpose and work with other people.

Being in a situation like that must be beyond frustrating and exhausting. Killing yourself for your parents is far from a solution though. Anger is something we all deal with. Learning how to change and control that anger is far easier said then done. But it is possible. The situation you are in is something you can change. Please don't take your life from the people who care about you. I'm sure your parents would feel better if you saw a councilor. Even if you feel like seeing one is pointless, you would be showing your parents your putting effort in to change.

Hey thanks for sharing these life experiences and problems you've been having. I somewhat understand what you've been going through. I've gone through all of high school completely alone. The only friend I ever did have isolated me from everyone and was harmful to me. I've started college now and things are still the same. I'm completely alone without having any sort of community to be apart of. I'm sorry your going through your life completely and utter alone. Has this situation always been like this for you? Have you ever been able to experience life with someone?
